transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Hello, this is calling from our company. Is this a good time to talk about your account?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.message: Um, hi... uh, not really, I'm kind of busy right now. Can you maybe call back later? Like, I'm standing here with a customer, so... it's just kinda bad timing.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message:
Hi, I'm so sorry—I really didn't mean to catch you at a bad moment. Thank you for letting me know, I truly appreciate your honesty. I know how important it is to focus on your customers when they're right in front of you.

Would it be alright if I called you back a little later? Maybe around [suggest a specific time, e.g., 3:00 PM] your time? Or if there’s a better time today or tomorrow, just let me know—I’m happy to work around what works best for you.

And don’t worry, there’s no need to have this conversation on the spot. I just want to make sure we can talk when you’re able to focus and feel comfortable.

Thanks again for taking a quick second to speak with me. I’ll make sure to call back at a better time. Take care!

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.message: Oh, um... sure, 3:00 might be okay? But honestly, I'm not sure—I mean, my schedule changes a lot. Maybe just... send me a text first before calling? That way I can see if I can talk. I don't want to miss anything, but yeah, just... text me first, please.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message:
Absolutely, I totally understand—your time is important, and I want to make this as easy as possible for you. I’ll text you first before I call, no problem at all. That way, you can decide in the moment if it’s a good time to talk.

I’ll send you a quick message around 2:45 or 3:00 PM today, just a heads-up from me—Sarah at ClearPath—so you’ll know it’s me. If you’re able to connect, great. If not, just let me know when might be better, and I’ll adjust.

Thank you again for being upfront with me. I know life gets busy, and I’m here to work with your schedule, not against it. I’ll be in touch by text shortly, and I appreciate your time.

Take care, and I’ll talk to you soon.
